_comment: An OpenBOR project is one game: its .pak file. A project can add OpenBOR's own save files to start from (what Export Save Data writes): the game's settings, its saved progress and its high scores.

slots.title: Game
slots.help: The game's .pak file (OpenBOR games are their data folder packed into one .pak).

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: OpenBOR's own save files for this game, as Export Save Data writes them: <game>.cfg (the settings, the keys among them), <game>.sav (the progress), <game>.hi (the high scores), <game>.scr (what the game's scripts keep). Their names must be the game's: test.pak's settings are test.cfg. The game starts with them.
